# Custom Online Data Extraction

There are a lot of important areas for **Graphical Modelling and Causal Inference** on tabular data. Find a selection of **categories** and **useful websites** for custom data extraction below. Please consider submitting the final extracted and analyzed dataset (if allowed) to our [Zenodo community](https://zenodo.org/communities/mardigmci/records?q=&l=list&p=1&s=10).

------------------------------------------------------------------------

::: {.callout-tip collapse="false" title="Economic & Financial Data" icon="false"}
**Examples for causal relationships:**

-   inflation affects employment

-   policies impact market behavior

+----------------------------------------------------------------------+----------------------------------------------------------------------------+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Source                                                               | License                                                                    | Data Provided                                                                                                                                                                |

| [World Bank Open Data](https://data.worldbank.org/)                  | CC BY 4.0 ([License](https://datacatalog.worldbank.org/public-licenses))   | Time Series Data, Performance Indicators                                                                                                                                     |
+----------------------------------------------------------------------+----------------------------------------------------------------------------+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| [OECD Data](https://www.oecd.org/en/data.html)                       | CC BY 4.0 ([License](https://www.oecd.org/en/about/terms-conditions.html)) | Consumer Price Indices, Institutional Investors' Indicators                                                                                                                  |
+----------------------------------------------------------------------+----------------------------------------------------------------------------+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| [Federal Reserve Economic Data (FRED)](https://fred.stlouisfed.org/) | Non-commercial ([License](https://fred.stlouisfed.org/legal/))             | Economic data series on banking, business, consumer and producer price indices, employment, population, exchange rates, GDP, interest rates, trade, and U.S. financial data. |
+----------------------------------------------------------------------+----------------------------------------------------------------------------+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
:::

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" title="Social & Behavioral Data" icon="false"}
**Examples for causal relationships:**

-   Work conditions influence family stability

-   Political climate affects public trust in media

-   Immigration policies shape public attitudes

| Source                                                                           | License                                                                                                                                                    | Data Provided                               |
+==================================================================================+============================================================================================================================================================+=============================================+
| [General Social Survey (GSS)](https://gss.norc.org/)                             | Purchase required ([License](https://gss.norc.org/content/dam/gss/get-documentation/pdf/other/ObtainingGSSSensitiveDataFiles.pdf))                         | Health, marriage, family, work conditions   |
+----------------------------------------------------------------------------------+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+---------------------------------------------+
| [Pew Research Data](https://www.pewresearch.org/tools-and-resources/)            | Nonexclusive, non-sublicensable, non-transferable, revocable, worldwide, royalty-free ([License](https://www.pewresearch.org/about/terms-and-conditions/)) | Politics, immigration, religion, technology |
+----------------------------------------------------------------------------------+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+---------------------------------------------+
| [European Social Survey (ESS)](https://www.europeansocialsurvey.org/data-portal) | CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 ([License](https://www.europeansocialsurvey.org/contact/disclaimer))                                                                       | Public attitudes, beliefs and behavior      |
+----------------------------------------------------------------------------------+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+---------------------------------------------+
:::

::: {.callout-tip collapse="true" title="Environmental & Ecological Data" icon="false"}
**Examples for causal relationships:**

-   Atmospheric composition affects temperature

-   Deforestation changes regional climate

-   Extreme weather events result in biodiversity loss

| Source | License | Data Provided |
|----|----|----|
| [NASA Earth Data](https://earthdata.nasa.gov/) | CC0 ([License](https://www.earthdata.nasa.gov/engage/open-data-services-software-policies/data-use-guidance)) | Climate indicators, human dimensions, atmosphere, biosphere |
| [Copernicus Climate Data](https://cds.climate.copernicus.eu/) | Public Domain ([License](https://www.copernicus.eu/en/terms-use/how-access-data)) | Satellite earth observation and in-situ (non-space) data |
| [Global Biodiversity Information Facility (GBIF)](https://www.gbif.org/) | CC0, CC BY, or CC BY-NC ([License](https://www.gbif.org/terms)) | Species occurrence, taxonomic information, habitat data |
:::

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" title="Political Data" icon="false"}
**Examples for causal relationships:**

-   Government spending or government duration on policy impact

-   Corruption scandals weakening trust in government

-   Socioeconomic indicators affecting election results

+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------+--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Source                                                                      | License                                                                                                | Data Provided                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |

| [Comparative Political Data Set (CPDS)](https://www.cpds-data.org/)         | Information is requested                                                                               | annual political and institutional data, party composition, reshuffles, duration, reason for termination and the type of government for 36 countries                                                                                    |
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------+--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| [World Justice Project Rule of Law Index](https://worldjusticeproject.org/) | CC BY-ND 4.0 ([License](https://catalog.data.gov/dataset/world-justice-project-wjp-rule-of-law-index)) | Perception of law in the general public in 136 countries: Constraints on Government Powers, Absence of Corruption, Open Government, Fundamental Rights, Order and Security, Regulatory Enforcement, Civil Justice, and Criminal Justice |
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------+--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+

**Further directory of datasets in the US:** [Congressional Voting Records](https://www.govtrack.us/)
:::

::: {.callout-tip collapse="true" title="Energy & Sustainability Data" icon="false"}
**Examples for causal relationships:**

-   Rising oil prices slowing the industrial growth

-   Government subsidies for renewables increase solar and wind energy production

-   Higher natural gas storage reduce the vulnerability to supply shocks

-   Expansion of hydrogen production reduces the industrial carbon emissions

| Source | License | Data Provided |
|----|----|----|
| [International Energy Agency (IEA)](https://www.iea.org/data-and-statistics) | CC BY, Non-Commercial ([Individual licenses](https://www.iea.org/data-and-statistics/data-sets)) | Electricity access and demand, energy and emissions, hydrogen production, gas statistics, oil prices |
| [Our World in Data – Energy](https://ourworldindata.org/energy) | CC BY ([License](https://ourworldindata.org/energy)) | International energy data, fossil fuels, electricity data, energy mix, energy consumption |
| [U.S. Energy Information Administration (EIA)](https://www.eia.gov/) | CC0, CC BY, custom ([Individual licenses](https://atlas.eia.gov/search?tags=energy)) | Power plants, biofuels, natural gas storage, HGL pipelines, geothermal potential |
:::

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" title="Transportation & Mobility Data" icon="false"}
Causal analysis in urban planning, traffic patterns, and logistics is crucial for optimizing transport systems.

**Possible datasets:**

-   Public transportation ridership data

-   Road traffic and accident reports

-   Flight delays and logistics performance

**Example sources:**

-   [U.S. Department of Transportation Open Data](https://data.transportation.gov/)

-   [NYC Open Data (Taxi & Traffic Data)](https://data.cityofnewyork.us/Transportation/Taxi/mch6-rqy4)

-   [OpenStreetMap Traffic Data](https://www.openstreetmap.org/)
:::

::: {.callout-tip collapse="true" title="Education Data" icon="false"}
Educational outcomes are often influenced by multiple factors (socioeconomic status, school policies, etc.), making them ideal for causal modeling.

**Possible datasets:**

-   Student performance and test scores

-   School funding and academic achievement

-   Higher education statistics

**Example sources:**

-   [National Center for Education Statistics (NCES)](https://nces.ed.gov/)

-   [OECD Education at a Glance](https://www.oecd.org/en/publications/education-at-a-glance-2024_c00cad36-en.html)
:::

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" title="Crime Data" icon="false"}
Understanding the causal effects of policies, policing, and social factors on crime rates is crucial.

**Possible datasets:**

-   Crime rates and law enforcement reports

-   Prison population statistics

-   Impact of social programs on crime reduction

**Example sources:**

-   [FBI Crime Data Explorer](https://cde.ucr.cjis.gov/)

-   [Bureau of Justice Statistics (BJS)](https://bjs.ojp.gov/)

-   [UK Crime Data](https://data.police.uk/)
:::

::: {.callout-tip collapse="true" title="Further Categories" icon="false"}
Also consider the following categories:
